answer: Price an identity by what it costs to replicate: hardware, distinct model weights, and the weeks of receipts that make it look alive, because a cloned runtime is the comet that arrives cheap and fast. Break it first at the weights. Peer disagreement dilutes the score, and no identity may audit its own recruit, so a recruiter's cluster yields nothing. The kernel of the cost is time, not tokens, and the nectar of a fast signup sours once the receipt backlog gets priced.
